name: Yatohime Zankikou Extra Kimagure Karasu to Yanchahime
original_name: 夜刀姫斬鬼行えくすとら 気まぐれカラスとやんちゃ姫
source:
Fandisc includes two short stories featuring heroines Riko and Hainrike von Erlenmeyer:

1. A secret day
2. Two princesses 「二人の姫」

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]

本Fan Disc收录两篇短篇故事，由女主角鹤城理子与海因莉克·冯·厄伦迈尔担任主角：
